statement: Given two tuples connected by a finite chain of the operations of [lem-pur-generating-tuple-chain], their concrete boundary products transported to any specified common closed support agree.

proof.text: First normalize frameClosedCoefficientIso on the epic constant restriction. This makes these canonical isomorphisms compose and gives the identity case. A unit scaling or swap is an instance of unit/permutation invariance. A shear uses the stated interpolation equality, cancelling the inverse coefficient transport. Induct over the finite elementary chain. The final support isomorphism equals the specified endpoint isomorphism because the support immersion is monic.

theorem frameProductOnSupport_elementary (P : PurityFiniteSetting.{u})
    {Z X : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (a : X ⟶ Spec (.of P.field.k)) (c : ℕ) (f g : Fin c → Γ(X, ⊤))
    (ef : X.zeroLocusSubscheme (Set.range f) ≅ Z)
    (hf : ef.hom ≫ i = X.zeroLocusSubschemeι (Set.range f))
    (eg : X.zeroLocusSubscheme (Set.range g) ≅ Z)
    (hg : eg.hom ≫ i = X.zeroLocusSubschemeι (Set.range g))
    (h : Relation.ReflTransGen (Module.GeneratingTupleStep (R := Γ(X, ⊤))) f g) :
    P.frameProductOnSupport i a c f ef hf = P.frameProductOnSupport i a c g eg hg
